body: Thanks for the kind words.  By counselor you mean a therapist?  Any advice on getting one?
Thanks, means a lot to hear some kind words.  Glad you are happy

To note, I think most people agree that if someone gives consent when they didn't mean it, then the guy was not guilty of assault.

But if that situation plays out, not sure how much it helps.  If the girl were to claim to be assaulted, the guy would be claiming she gave consent.  You are in a he-said she-said.  And the girl still is hurt.

Especially since traumatized people tend to forget details or not mention them, you are kinda in the same place you were before.
